name: OGX Group Berhad
overview: OGX Group Berhad 于2026年在ACE Market完成首次公开募股（IPO），以支持其业务运营。公司业务线涵盖网络、网络安全、企业数据中心解决方案、IT基础设施产品分销及支持与专业服务，但除上述物业收购外，公告中未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: OGX Group Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market in 2026 and proposed the acquisition of a warehouse and office property in Selangor for RM19.0 million to support its business operations.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note_en: The company proposed to acquire a warehouse and office property in Selangor as an operational facility.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of a 3-storey detached warehouse with a 4-storey office annex and guardhouse in Selangor for RM19.0 million cash to expand operational facilities.
